描述_EN: cizhou ware was characterised by a decoration consisting of painted, incised, or carved motifs highlighted in black, white or brown on a monochrome ground. it belongs to the so-called cizhou wares, after the name of one of the major centres of production in north china that flourished during the song- jin period (960-1234) and the ming dynasty (1368-1644). in this example, the final pattern is executed by cutting through the glaze to create a strong contrast between the black glaze and the sandy buff coloured body of the jar. this beautiful stoneware jar with a small neck and ring handles, was used for storing and serving alcohol, and would probably have had a stopper.
描述_ZN: Cizhou ware的特点是，其装饰包括在单色地面上用黑色、白色或棕色强调的绘画、刻画或雕刻图案。 它属于所谓的Cizhou wares，是以中国北方的一个主要生产中心的名字命名的，在宋金时期（960-1234）和明朝（1368-1644）很繁荣。 在这个例子中，最后的图案是通过切割釉面来实现的，在黑色的釉面和沙质的水色罐体之间形成了强烈的对比。 这个漂亮的石器罐有一个小的颈部和环形把手，是用来储存和盛酒的，而且可能有一个塞子。
